| Model | Overall | True | False | Unknown |

| RoBERTa-MNLI | 37.7% | 23.5% | 89.0% | 0.5% |

**NLI gain 是 NLI-general 而非 DeBERTa-specific**——三个架构在 w≥3 时都显著提升 SC，但幅度不同：
